title: Clofazimine
dek: A riminophenazine half-leprosy, half-TB. Membrane/redox activity, very long half-life, skin pigmentation, QTc, and Rv0678 cross-talk with BDQ. The C in many 9-month and BDLLfxC recipes.
story: Clofazimine is a fat-soluble riminophenazine that accumulates in macrophages and fat for months. Mechanism is messy (redox cycling, membrane effects) compared with RpoB. WHO uses it in the 2022 9-month oral, in BDLLfxC (dropped if FQ-S), and in some modified 9-month mixes. It is Group B, not Group A.
Rv0678 LOF raises CFZ MIC along with BDQ — recount both if the regulator falls. Intrinsic CFZ MICs already sit near CCs; humility applies.
Patients need to hear about pink-brown skin and body-fluid discoloration before week 8, not at the wedding. QTc stacks with BDQ/FQ/DLM. GI crystalline deposition is a rare surgical surprise.
deep: Still on board after “completion” — useful and selecting.
Not a TPT drug. Not DS first-line.
Leprosy dosing lore does not automatically transfer to TB mg/kg; use TB tables.

visual.caption: Clofazimine is pharmacology you can see: colour, ECG, fat depot, and a pump shared with BDQ. Not a gyrase, not a RNAP.

example.title: FQ-S on BDLLfxC, still on CFZ at month 2
example.setup: gyrA WT returned at week 3; SOP said drop CFZ; nobody did.

steps.title: Prune
steps.body: FQ-S BDLLfxC → BDLLfx. Extra CFZ is extra QTc and extra colour without the trial’s reason.

steps.title: If Rv0678 is already wobbling, CFZ may be dead anyway
steps.body: Check the regulator before arguing to keep C “for strength.”

steps.title: Counsel the colour that already started
steps.body: It fades slowly. Honesty is adherence.

example.takeaway: CFZ is a long-lived Group B dye with a BDQ-linked pump.
